facts.fact: In Emmanuel Harunna v. NDPC (FHC/L/CS/1116/2024) the Federal High Court (Justice F.N. Ogazi) treated the Act as operative law, citing its Section 63 as prevailing over inconsistent law on processing of personal data; the article is dated 29 July 2026 and gives no judgment date.

Leadership reports the NDPC, with National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji and a Head of Legal, Enforcement and Regulations, issued a statement and directive in July 2026 after the Federal High Court upheld its power to designate and register Data Controllers and Processors of Major Importance; article dated 29 July 2026.
